site.name: Kundalini Spines
site.description: Kundalini Spines is a two-member underground hip-hop project built on mysticism, coded transmissions, sacred geometry, and street experience.

homepage._note: Superseded by the WEBSITEREADME.txt redesign — the homepage is now Hero -> Track Experience (data/tracks.json) -> Newsletter -> Bio -> simplified Footer. Fields below are kept only as a historical record of the pre-redesign layout.
homepage.identityStatement: Two Messengers. One Signal. Kundalini Spines moves through sacred geometry, coded lyricism, and the architecture of the spine itself — knowledge carried in plain sight, for anyone willing to listen closely enough to decode it.

entryPoints.label: Music
entryPoints.description: Releases, tracks, and the current signal.

messengers.intro: The Messengers don't claim mastery over the Signal. They receive it, preserve it, and carry it forward without weakening its meaning — witnesses first, performers second.

about.philosophy: The project moves between the sacred and the street — Metatron's Cube next to a blueprint, an X-ray beside a manuscript. Ancient knowledge, modern static. The spine sits at the center of all of it: thirty-three vertebrae, seven nodes, one signal moving through the whole structure.
about.transmissionsExplainer: Numbered pieces called Transmissions carry the Signal forward — visual, lyrical, sometimes both. Each one is filed once and never reused.
